title: Apply Substitutions
summary: Given a mapping of replacements and a text string with placeholders %var%, replace each placeholder with the corresponding value from the mapping.
statement: Given a mapping of replacements and a text string with placeholders %var%, replace each placeholder with the corresponding value from the mapping. Ensure the final text string contains no placeholders.
constraints: Replacement keys are unique, every placeholder references a defined key, and dependencies are acyclic.
A placeholder has the form %KEY% and replacement values may contain further placeholders.
Recursively expand every placeholder so the final text contains none.
hints: Replacement dependencies form an acyclic directed graph, so each key can be expanded once and memoized.
Parse placeholder pairs recursively and cache fully expanded mapping values.
Append literal spans; for each %KEY%, append expand_key(KEY); recursively expand the mapped value on first use.
Acyclicity guarantees termination, and memoization prevents repeated work for keys referenced many times.
editorial: Acyclicity guarantees termination, and memoization prevents repeated work for keys referenced many times.

tests.explanation: The two placeholders expand to abc and def, producing abc_def.
A expands through B, producing z.
